- [**Aletsch Arena**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The Aletsch Arena on the Aletsch Glacier: Enjoy the vantage points, hikes in the Aletsch Forest, glacier tours and top winter sports conditions.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/aletsch-arena/)
- [**Aletschhorn**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The second-highest peak in the Bernese Alps is also considered to be the coldest across the entire Alpine region. The highly glaciated Aletschhorn towers over the UNESCO-listed Jungfrau-Aletsch area.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/aletschhorn-4193m-asl/)
- [**Aletsch Glacier**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The Aletsch Glacier is a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site that stretches from the Bernese Oberland into Valais. Experience the ice giant from the Jungfraujoch.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/aletsch-glacier/)
- [**Aletscharena paragliding for children from Fiesch**\\
\\
OfferFieschNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
Fly like a bird over the Aletsch Arena with the tandem paragliding "Kids Flight Gletschi", designed for children in the morning under calm conditions.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/aletscharena-paragliding-for-children-from-fiesch/)
- [**Aletsch Glacier Trail**\\
\\
RouteRiederalp\\
\\
Flanked by 32 4,000-metre peaks and only a few minutes from the Bettmerhorn upper station, a spectacular experience awaits you in the form of the Great Aletsch Glacier.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/aletsch-panoramaweg-the-swiss-glacier-trail/)
- [**Aletsch Panoramaweg, Stage 1/3**\\
\\
RouteBlatten-Belalp\\
\\
Best views of glacier snout and lower part of Aletsch Glacier from Aletschbor. Over a hanging bridge to Aletschwald (forest) with 100-year-old Swiss stone pines. Villa Cassel looms like an eagle's nest on the Riederfurka ridge, surrounded by the magnificent Valais mountains.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/aletsch-panoramaweg-39_01/)
- [**Aletsch Piste**\\
\\
ExperienceBettmeralp\\
\\
The ski pistes at the two car-free villages of Bettmeralp and Riederalp afford unobstructed views of the highest mountains in Switzerland. The Aletsch Arena also enjoys a sun-drenched setting. This area’s most striking downhill run takes you from the Bettmerhorn to the Riederalp.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/aletsch-piste/)
- [**Aletsch Golf Tournament Week**\\
\\
EventRiederalpAugust 6, 2027\\
\\
Top-level golf for every handicap!](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/aletsch-golfturnierwoche/)
- [**Aletsch Panoramaweg, Stage 3/3**\\
\\
RouteBellwald\\
\\
The trail follows old Alpine paths down to the Burg, a rock massif of gneiss smoothed by glaciers. Against the backdrop of the Goms mountains, the Fiescher Glacier becomes clearly visible. The 160-metre-long Aspi-Titter suspension bridge points the way to the idyllic Goms mountain village of Bellwald.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/aletsch-panoramaweg-39_03/)
- [**Aletsch Panoramaweg**\\
\\
RouteAletsch Arena\\
\\
Three days under the spell of the Valais glacier landscape. Sensational scenic tour with many vantage points onto the two longest glaciers in the Alps. The grey-white of ice and rock contrasting with shades of green in the Aletschwald (forest) provides stunning scenic beauty.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/aletsch-panoramaweg/)
- [**Aletsch Halbmarathon Weekend**\\
\\
EventBettmeralpJune 25, 2027\\
\\
Classic Running Event at a UNESCO World Heritage Site](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/aletsch-halbmarathon-weekend/)
- [**Aletsch Explorer \| Aletsch Arena**\\
\\
OfferFieschNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
The ultimate day pass for hiking, sightseeing and more.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/aletsch-explorer-aletsch-arena/)
- [**Aletsch Bahnen**\\
\\
ExperienceBettmeralp\\
\\
Take the Aletsch Bahnen to three peaks above the Great Aletsch Glacier, from Mörel, Betten or Fiesch to the car-free Aletsch Arena.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/take-the-aletsch-cable-car-services-to-the-aletsch-arena/)
- [**Aletsch - Via ferrata on the biggest Alpine glacier**\\
\\
ExperienceBlatten-Belalp\\
\\
A via ferrata in a lakeside setting, arranged with great originality and with plenty of ironwork: ideal for scrambling up the steep rock above the water. Special highlights are the giant suspension bridge and the final Tyrolienne traverse (can be bypassed if necessary).](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/aletsch-via-ferrata-on-the-biggest-alpine-glacier/)
- [**Aletsch Winter Get-Together**\\
\\
EventBreiten-Mörel-Filet-BisterDecember 10, 2026\\
\\
Come celebrate with us at the Winter Gathering throughout the Aletsch Arena!](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/aletsch-wintertraeff/)
- [**Aletscharena paragliding tandem from Fiesch**\\
\\
OfferFieschNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
Experience the feeling of weightlessness with an adventurous tandem paragliding flight and enjoy the view of the Aletsch Arena.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/aletscharena-paragliding-tandem-from-fiesch/)
- [**Aletschbord**\\
\\
Panorama](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/panoramas/aletschbord/)
- [**Aletsch Panoramaweg, Stage 2/3**\\
\\
RouteRiederalp\\
\\
A string of vantage points provides a natural spectacle: to the north, the view of the Aletsch Glacier in the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage Site. To the south the 4000-metre peaks of Valais. On the gentle descent to the Märjelensee lake, cotton grasses and small tarns contrast with the rock and ice.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/aletsch-panoramaweg-39_02/)
- [**Aletsch Arena Ticket Explorer Pass**\\
\\
OfferBreiten-Mörel-Filet-BisterDecember 4, 2026\\
\\
With this day pass, you can freely explore the mountain railways of the Aletsch Arena. The paradise surrounding the Aletsch Glacier offers you many wonderful hikes and views in the UNESCO area.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/aletsch-arena-ticket-explorer-pass/)
- [**Aletsch Snowpark**\\
\\
ExperienceBettmeralp\\
\\
Ein Hotspot für alle Freestyler: Denn auf den Kicker-Lines oder der Rail-Line des TFI Snowparks kann man sich so richtig austoben.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/tfi-snowpark/)
